topics.name: Routine and q Editor Boundary
topics.purpose: Define Routine and q backend/target editing as candidate definitions with exact refs, separate from invoking `&`, `q`, `qc` or `qt`.

semantics.routine_rule: Routine edits create candidate Routine definition/revision.
semantics.q_rule: q backend/model/target bindings are explicit candidate config.
semantics.backend_rule: Backends such as dummyLLM, doubleword and nvidia are exact backend identities/bindings.
semantics.target_rule: q/qc target selection is explicit and never hidden UI focus.
semantics.execution_rule: Saving/editing never invokes the Routine or q family.
semantics.authority_rule: Editor access does not grant q/Routine execution authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: selected editor pane becomes qc target
editing q grants model execution rights
candidate config mutates live backend immediately

references.purpose: Routine Editor edits exact Routine definitions.
q Editor configures q-family bindings only.
